findings.name: Unencrypted RDS database storing PHI
findings.description: At-rest encryption is disabled on the primary patient database, which stores protected health information.

findings.name: Root account has active access keys
findings.description: The account root user has two active long-lived access keys, contrary to best practice.

findings.name: IAM service account with AdministratorAccess and no MFA
findings.description: Deployment service account holds full administrator privileges and does not enforce MFA.

findings.name: Security group exposes RDP to the internet
CloudTrail audit logging disabled in primary region
findings.description: No management-event audit trail is being recorded in us-east-1.

findings.name: EBS snapshot shared publicly
findings.description: A volume snapshot is shared with all AWS accounts.

findings.name: Backup bucket without versioning
findings.description: Object versioning is disabled, weakening ransomware recovery.

findings.name: Kubernetes control plane past end-of-life
findings.description: Cluster runs Kubernetes 1.24, which is end-of-life.
